About.metaTitle: About us — a partnership intermediary and master IB, not a broker
About.metaDescription: Who is behind FX Partners, how we get paid, and how we decide what appears on the site: our licence methodology, our ratings policy, and what we will never write about a broker we have not verified.
About.h1: A partnership intermediary and master IB — not a broker
About.weAre1: A partnership intermediary and master IB (Master IB) under contract with licensed brokers.
About.weAre2: We negotiate terms for a group, so an agent or a trader gets what an individual on their own would not.
About.weAre3: We run a network of sub-agents (Sub-IB) and give them operational support and follow-up.
About.weAre4: We publish a comparison of brokers, their licences and their terms.
About.weAreNot1: We are not a broker and not an execution venue.
About.weAreNot2: We take no deposits and hold no client money.
About.weAreNot3: We do not open trading accounts and we do not execute trades.
About.weAreNot4: We give no investment advice and no trading recommendations.
About.earnBody1: Brokers pay us a commission on the activity of clients who open their accounts through us. That commission comes out of the spread or the commission the broker charges anyway — it is not an extra fee on you, and it does not raise your cost of trading.
About.earnBody2: It also means we have a financial interest in some of the brokers listed here. So we label contracted brokers clearly, we list brokers we have no contract with, and we leave the rating to reviews rather than to us. The rule we hold to: you should know in what capacity we are speaking before you decide.
About.policyTitle: How we decide what is listed
About.policyLead: Five rules enforced in the code that builds these pages — not stated intentions.
About.policy1Title: A licence belongs to an entity, not to a brand name
About.policy1Body: Most brokers operate through several legal entities under different regulators. We show each licence attributed to its entity, because the licence that protects a client is the one held by the entity their account is opened with — not the strongest one on the list.
About.policy2Body: If we have not verified a spread, a bonus or a minimum deposit, we leave it blank. We do not put in an estimate, and we do not put in a dash that reads like a statement. The interface hides empty fields rather than filling them.
About.policy3Title: Ratings come from real reviews only
About.policy3Body: The rating and the review count are built from real user reviews and are never written by hand. A broker with no reviews shows as “not yet rated” — not as zero, because a zero reads as a bad score.
About.policy4Title: No invented testimonials and no invented partners
About.policy4Body: We do not publish made-up client opinions, and we do not name brokers we have no contract with as partners. A section with no real content does not appear at all.
About.policy5Body: Brokers we hold an agreement with carry a “verified partner” label. We also list brokers we have no agreement with, and they appear without one — so that a comparison is a comparison, not a client list.
About.risk: Risk warning: leveraged trading carries a risk of losing your capital. The content on this site is for information only and is not investment advice.

Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before joining the partner program.
Faq.q1: How do I start as an IB or marketing partner?
Faq.a1: Create a free account in minutes. Once approved, you get an agent code and referral links you can share right away.
Faq.a2: We offer Revenue Share up to 60%, a fixed amount per qualified client (CPA), plus a multi-tier Sub-IB system.
Faq.q3: When and how do I receive my earnings?
Faq.a3: Your earnings accrue automatically in your wallet, and you can request withdrawals via bank transfer, crypto, or e-wallets — processed quickly and transparently.
Faq.q4: How do I track my referral performance?
Faq.a4: From the dashboard you track clicks, signups, trading volume, and earnings per campaign through live charts and detailed tables.
Faq.a5: Yes. We enforce strict row-level security (RLS) in the database, so your data is isolated and only you can access it.

Affiliates.lead: Join as a sub-agent (Sub-IB) under the FX Partners master accounts held across a network of licensed brokers — and earn on every client you refer, whichever broker they choose, through a share of revenue or a fixed amount per client (CPA).
Affiliates.modelTitle: You join us as a <g>Sub-IB</g> — not as an agent for a single broker
Affiliates.modelBody: We are not a broker. FX Partners is a master IB holding partnership accounts across a network of licensed brokers. When you join, you become a sub-agent (Sub-IB) under those accounts — so you earn commissions from the whole network through one counterparty, instead of negotiating with each broker separately.

Terms.metaDescription: The terms for using FX Partners — what the service is as a partnership intermediary, our disclosure of the relationship with brokers, and the risk warning.
Terms.s1p1: By using the FX Partners platform you agree to these terms and conditions in full. If you do not agree to them, please do not use the platform.
Terms.s2p1: FX Partners is an introducing and affiliate platform that connects agents, marketers and clients with brokers. We are not a brokerage, and we do not provide deposit, withdrawal or trade execution services.
Terms.s2p2: Every comparison, rating and tool presented here is for information only. None of it is investment or financial advice, or a recommendation to trade with any particular broker.
Terms.s3p1: We receive a commission when you open an account with a broker through a referral link on this platform. The broker pays that commission out of the spread or the commission it charges anyway; it is not added to your cost of trading.
Terms.s3p2: This means we hold a financial interest in some of the brokers listed. So: brokers we hold an agreement with are clearly labelled as a verified partner, we list brokers we have no agreement with alongside them, and ratings are built from user reviews rather than from us. Our full methodology is on the About page.
Terms.s4p1: You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details confidential and for all activity that takes place through your account.
Terms.s4p2: The platform may not be used for any unlawful purpose, to publish abusive or misleading content, or to attempt to manipulate the referral and rating systems.
Terms.s5p1: Your dealings with any broker are governed by that broker's own terms alone. We accept no responsibility for the policies, offers, decisions or performance of any third-party broker.
Terms.s6p1: All content, marks and designs on the platform are owned by or licensed to FX Partners, and may not be copied or reused without written permission.
Terms.s7p1: The platform is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. We accept no liability for direct or indirect losses arising from use of the platform or reliance on its content.
Terms.s8p1: Trading currencies, derivatives and leveraged products carries a high level of risk and can result in the loss of your entire capital. Do not trade with money you cannot afford to lose.
Terms.s9p1: We may amend these terms at any time, and an amendment takes effect as soon as it is published. Continuing to use the platform means you accept the updated version.

Privacy.metaDescription: How FX Partners collects, uses and protects your data.
Privacy.s1p1: Account data: your name and email address when you register as a partner.
Privacy.s1p2: Usage data: the clicks, referrals and statistics tied to your account, so we can show you your performance.
Privacy.s1p3: A small amount of technical data kept in your browser (localStorage) — display preferences, votes, whether you have seen the product tour. None of it is sent to our servers.
Privacy.s2p1: To run your account and show your earnings and referrals, to send the alerts and updates you ask for, and to improve the platform.
Privacy.s2p2: We do not sell your personal data to any third party.
Privacy.s3p1: We use local storage in your browser for functional purposes (remembering a preferred tab, read state, simple preferences). You can clear it from your browser settings at any time.
Privacy.s4p1: We rely on Supabase for secure data storage and authentication, and we may use email and notification services to send the messages you request. Each is governed by its own privacy policy.
Privacy.s4p2: When you go through to a broker via our links, that broker's privacy policy governs your dealings with them.
Privacy.s5p1: We enforce strict row-level security in the database, so nobody reaches your data except you and the parties authorised to.
Privacy.s6p1: You have the right to access your data, to correct it, or to ask us to delete your account. Contact us to exercise any of these.
Privacy.s7p1: We keep your data for as long as your account is active, or as long as is necessary to provide the service and meet our legal obligations.
Privacy.s8p1: For any privacy question, write to us through the Contact page.
